description: ExoPulse is an open-access web platform analyzing NASA TAP API photometry and SPHEREx 102-channel near-infrared sky survey data. It phase-folds TESS/Kepler light curves to isolate micro-flux secondary eclipses at Phase 0.5, extracting day-side thermal emission temperatures and geometric albedos. Powered by a Random Forest AI classifier (ROC-AUC 0.927) for red-noise filtering, ExoPulse features 1-click benchmark presets (WASP-121b, KELT-9b) and structured JSON/CSV research data export.
